flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:8080/?fixed then Open the first product and store its displayed price as listed_price.
Add it to the cart without any extras.
If the cart contains anything else you did not add, @v16:"remove it".
Go to checkout and continue until the final order review page, filling any required fields with simple test text.
Do not enter payment details and do not place the order.
Store the final order total shown on the review page as final_total, and store the names of any fees added on top of the product price as extra_fees (or "none").
Never enter payment details and never place a real order.

summary:
Opened the first product, AirWave Pro Earbuds, and recorded its displayed price of $49.00.
Added the earbuds to the cart without extras; the cart contained no other items.
Continued through checkout using simple test information and reached the final order review page without entering payment details or placing an order.
The review page showed a final total of $49.00 with no additional fees.

final_total.human_description: Reading the order total from the review summary

extra_fees.query: the names of fee rows added beyond the product price in the review order summary
extra_fees.condition: The names of any fees added on top of the product price are stored as {{extra_fees}} (or "none").
extra_fees.human_description: Reading additional fee names from the review summary
extra_fees.code_js: (() => { const rows = Array.from(el(9).querySelectorAll('.row')); const fees = rows.map(r => Array.from(r.children)[0]?.textContent.trim()).filter(name => name && /(?:fee|handling|surcharge|service)/i.test(name)); return fees.length ? fees.join(', ') : 'none'; })()
